## History

Charlotta, whose birth name was Leonora, worked as a maid at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for the eccentric Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). She helped entertain visitors like [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), and later confided her worries to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) regarding Miss Lavendar's melancholic mood. During the preparations for Miss Lavendar's romantic reconciliation and eventual wedding to [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), Charlotta assisted with the arrangements and observed the couple's happy reunion.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), +19 more_

## Quotes

> "it’s plain to be seen you and Miss Lavendar have got a secret and I think, begging your pardon if I’m too forward, Miss Shirley, ma’am, that it’s real mean not to tell me when we’ve all been such chums."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)

> “Oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am,” she breathed, “I peeked from the kitchen window . . . and he’s awful handsome . . . and just the right age for Miss Lavendar. And oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am, do you think it would be much harm to listen at the door?”
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P65](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0065)

> "But I’m sure I shan’t sleep a blessed wink, Miss Shirley, ma’am, for fear that something’ll go wrong at the last minute . . . the cream won’t whip . . . or Mr. Irving’ll have a stroke and not be able to come."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014)

> "but there’s so much to do yet . . . and oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am, I’m skeered it’s going to rain and I wish you’d get up and tell me you think it ain’t."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P19](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0019)

> “No, I can understand that,” said Charlotta. “A wedding ain’t poetry. Why, Miss Shirley, ma’am, you’re crying! What for?”
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P74](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0074)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--charlotta.md)

Charlotta first meets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) get lost in the woods and arrive at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Charlotta becomes a wholehearted admirer and friend of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as they interact during Anne's visits to the lodge. The two share tea together and spend time in the garden, with Charlotta confiding in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her concerns for her mistress.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +7 more_

- Friend of — wholehearted admirer and friend  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--diana-barry.md)

Charlotta meets [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when the two lost girls discover [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) in October. She warmly welcomes [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) into the home and joins her for tea. Their paths continue to cross through events surrounding Miss Lavendar's wedding preparations.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +14 more_

- Friend of — welcomes her warmly at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta serves as the young handmaiden to Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), being the fourth maid in a succession of 'Charlottas.' She deeply cares for her mistress, confiding her worries about Miss Lavendar's melancholic mood to visitors. Charlotta actively assists around the estate and shares in the joy of Miss Lavendar's eventual reconciliation and marriage to [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +19 more_

- Serves under — employer/master to handmaiden  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044)</sub>

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--shirley.md)

Charlotta forms a friendly bond with [Shirley](../character/shirley.md), coming to consider her a good friend. They spend time together during visits to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), picking berries and chatting in the garden. Charlotta also visits [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) during the preparations for Miss Lavendar's upcoming wedding.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), +15 more_

- Friend of — chums  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>
